context: This criteria evaluates proficiency in using babel-plugin-react-compiler to analyze React components. It assesses the engineer's ability to configure Babel transformations, integrate the React Compiler plugin, capture compilation diagnostics, and parse compiled output to extract memoization information.

checklist.name: Babel Configuration
checklist.description: Correctly configures Babel with parseAsync using appropriate parser plugins for TypeScript ('typescript') and JSX ('jsx') to parse React component code

checklist.name: React Compiler Integration
checklist.description: Correctly integrates babel-plugin-react-compiler into the Babel transformation pipeline using transformFromAstAsync with the plugin in the plugins array

checklist.name: Diagnostic Capture Setup
checklist.description: Configures PluginOptions with a logger object that implements the logEvent callback to capture CompileError events and extract error details including reason and location

checklist.name: Error Extraction
checklist.description: Correctly extracts compilation errors from logged events, formats error messages, and converts SourceLocation objects to 'line:column' string format (e.g., '5:10') or null when location is unavailable

checklist.name: Memoization Detection
checklist.description: Detects memoization in compiled code by checking for the presence of the cache helper import (e.g., 'import { c as _c } from "react/compiler-runtime"') in the output

checklist.name: Cache Size Extraction
checklist.description: Extracts the cache size from the compiled output by parsing the cache initialization pattern (e.g., 'const $ = _c(5)') and extracting the numeric argument passed to the cache function
